jobs.title: Account Manager for Academic Work Geneva!
jobs.description: Are you looking for a company ready to bet on your raw potential? Do you have a competitive spirit and see B2B development as a true strategic game? At Academic Work, your CV matters little; it’s your persuasive power and ambition that count. Come prove what you’re capable of: take on the challenge and pass the test! Account Manager for Academic Work Geneva! About the role Don't leave fit to chance! At Academic Work, we are experts in recruiting early-career professionals, with a clear ambition: to become THE leader in performance prediction. For nearly 30 years, we have been deploying our expertise across 6 countries. We continue to grow, which is why we are looking for two Account Managers to strengthen our Geneva team. Our Geneva office consists of 25 employees driven by a culture of ambition and more than 150 consultants whom we proudly support every month. What sets us apart? A strong corporate culture, unwavering commitment from our employees, and client satisfaction that motivates us daily to go further. So, ready to make a difference? Tasks The role of Account Manager is a clever mix of determination and strategic thinking. You constantly wear two hats: that of the Hunter, driving our expansion, and that of the Advisor, a trusted partner to business leaders. Your talent? Knowing how to open doors where others see obstacles, then adapting our expertise to market realities and available talent to create a unique solution. Specifically, you manage your activity around four axes: Prospecting and portfolio development: This is the heart of your mission. You build and manage your own client portfolio from A to Z. Cold calling is your daily lever to convince and secure strategic meetings with business leaders. Needs analysis and negotiation: You meet directors and managers to analyse their needs. You establish the profiles of sought candidates and lead pricing negotiations. Your goal is to convince your interlocutors of the value of our support to build long-term collaborations. Market expertise and internal synergy: Drawing on your field knowledge, you provide insightful advice to your clients. Once the need is identified, you work closely with our recruiters. Rigor and results: You are responsible for your performance. To ensure consistent results, you apply our working methods precisely, from first contact to closing the deal. We seek temperament, not a CV No matter your studies or professional background, we look for the following character traits: A sense of conviction: You do not hesitate to give your opinion, even in front of an authority figure. You prefer frank discussion over easy consensus. Unwavering resilience: Failure drives you to double your efforts. A "no" is never an end in itself, but the starting point to find another solution. A taste for achievement: You need to set challenges to move forward. You enjoy competition and seek an environment where your efforts are rewarded fairly. A natural curiosity: You like to dig into a subject to understand its roots. You ask the right questions to understand a problem before acting. A sense of autonomy: You appreciate the freedom to organise your days and demonstrate great personal discipline to achieve your goals. Requirements 0 to 3 years of experience after finishing your studies. No sales experience needed: we train you from A to Z through our AW Sales Academy . Fluent French and advanced English level (C1). Driving licence (category B). What we offer you A high-performers ecosystem: A demanding and stimulating environment where we lift each other up and celebrate successes together (trips, kick-offs). Impact as a true driver: You will have a direct impact on your clients’ business and the trajectory of young talents. Think big & make it happen: A progressive fixed salary and a completely uncapped commission system. Here, your ambition is the only limit. The AW Sales Academy: An elite programme (2 weeks onboarding + ongoing coaching) to transform your potential into B2B expertise. Strategic autonomy: Great freedom to manage your schedule and steer your client portfolio. Our predictive recruitment process We use science to validate your potential: Alva Labs tests (logic & personality): Your passport to the next step. Telephone contact (10 min) Interview with a recruiter Interview with Hiring Managers (including a case study to prepare) Welcome to the team!

jobs.title: Account Manager pour Academic Work Genève !
jobs.description: Tu cherches une entreprise prête à parier sur ton potentiel brut ? Tu as un tempérament de compétiteur et tu vois le développement B2B comme un véritable jeu de stratégie ? Chez Academic Work, ton CV importe peu, c'est ta force de conviction et ton ambition qui comptent. Viens te prouver de quoi tu es capable : relève le défi et passe le test ! Account Manager pour Academic Work Genève ! A propos du rôle Don't leave fit to chance ! Chez Academic Work, nous sommes les experts du recrutement des professionnels en début de carrière, avec une ambition claire : devenir LE leader de la prédiction de performance. Depuis près de 30 ans, nous déployons notre expertise dans 6 pays. Nous continuons notre croissance, et c'est pourquoi nous recherchons deux Account Managers pour renforcer notre équipe genevoise. Notre bureau de Genève est composé de 25 collaborateurs animés par une culture de l'ambition et de plus de 150 consultants que nous sommes fiers d'accompagner chaque mois. Ce qui nous distingue ? Une culture d'entreprise forte, un engagement sans faille de nos collaborateurs, et une satisfaction client qui nous motive chaque jour à aller plus loin. Alors, prêt(e) à faire la différence ? Tâches Le rôle d'Account Manager est un savant mélange de détermination et de réflexion stratégique. Tu portes en permanence deux casquettes : celle du Hunter, moteur de notre expansion, et celle du Conseiller, partenaire de confiance des chefs d'entreprise. Ton talent ? Savoir ouvrir des portes là où les autres voient des obstacles, puis adapter notre expertise aux réalités du marché et des talents disponibles pour créer une solution unique. Concrètement, tu pilotes ton activité autour de quatre axes : Prospection et développement de portefeuille : C'est le cœur de ta mission. Tu construis et gères ton propre portefeuille de clients de A à Z. Le cold calling est ton levier quotidien pour convaincre et obtenir des rendez-vous stratégiques avec des responsables d'entreprise. Analyse de besoin et négociation : Tu rencontres des directeurs et managers pour analyser leurs besoins. Tu établis les profils de candidats recherchés et mènes les négociations tarifaires. Ton but est de convaincre tes interlocuteurs de la valeur de notre accompagnement pour bâtir des collaborations à long terme. Expertise marché et synergie interne : Fort de ta connaissance du terrain, tu apportes un regard éclairé à tes clients. Une fois le besoin identifié, tu travailles en lien étroit avec nos recruteurs. Rigueur et résultats : Tu es responsable de tes performances. Pour assurer des résultats constants, tu appliques nos méthodes de travail avec précision, du premier contact jusqu'à la conclusion de l'accord (le closing ). Nous cherchons un tempérament, pas un CV Peu importe tes études ou ton passé professionnel, nous cherchons les traits de caractère suivants : Le sens de la conviction : Tu n'hésites pas à donner ton avis, même face à une figure d'autorité. Tu préfères une discussion franche au consensus facile. Une résilience sans faille : L'échec te pousse à redoubler d'efforts. Un "non" n'est jamais une fin en soi, mais le point de départ pour trouver une autre solution. Le goût de l'accomplissement : Tu as besoin de te fixer des défis pour avancer. Tu aimes la compétition et tu cherches un environnement où tes efforts sont récompensés à leur juste valeur. Une curiosité naturelle : Tu aimes creuser un sujet pour en comprendre les racines. Tu poses les bonnes questions pour comprendre un problème avant d'agir. Le sens de l'autonomie : Tu apprécies la liberté d'organiser tes journées et tu sais faire preuve d'une grande rigueur personnelle pour atteindre tes objectifs. Prérequis 0 à 3 ans d'expérience après la fin de tes études. Pas besoin d'expérience en Sales : nous te formons de A à Z via notre AW Sales Academy . Français parfait et niveau avancé en anglais (C1). Permis de conduire (catégorie B). Ce que nous t'offrons Un écosystème de high-performers : Un environnement exigeant et stimulant où l'on se tire vers le haut et où les succès sont célébrés ensemble (voyages, kick-offs). L'impact comme véritable moteur : Tu auras un impact direct sur le business de tes clients et sur la trajectoire des jeunes talents. Think big & make it happen : Un salaire fixe évolutif et un système de commissions totalement déplafonné. Ici, ton ambition est la seule limite. L'AW Sales Academy : Un programme d'élite (2 semaines d'onboarding + coaching continu) pour transformer ton potentiel en expertise B2B. Une autonomie stratégique : Une grande liberté pour gérer ton agenda et piloter ton portefeuille de clients. Notre processus de recrutement prédictif Nous utilisons la science pour valider ton potentiel : Tests Alva Labs (logique & personnalité) : Ton passeport pour la suite. Prise de contact téléphonique (10 min) Entretien avec un recruteur Entretien avec les Hiring Managers (incluant une étude de cas à préparer) Bienvenue dans l'équipe !

jobs.title: Senior Event Planning Manager
jobs.description: People at 1800 metres above sea level shape luxury mountain travel. Our dynamic and international team offers our guests smart luxury for an unparalleled holiday experience. As a team member of the luxurious Kulm Group, you are part of the key to our success. Together we make every stay inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we live our culture: discreet luxury, inspiration and life experience. Together we make this possible. This is your chance to become part of our defining culture: What you will achieve with us Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high-profile business events and bespoke celebrations – across two of Switzerland’s most renowned establishments. As Event Planning Manager , you accompany the entire planning process from enquiry to operational handover and ensure that every event is precisely planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed at both the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina. Your responsibilities: Operational detailed planning & implementation: Seamless takeover of confirmed bookings from Sales; detailed coordination of all processes including room concepts, F&B procedures, technology and individual guest requests. Hub within the house: Precise creation and timely distribution of Function Sheets (BEOs) as well as daily close coordination with Banqueting, Kitchen, Service, Technical Services and Front Office of both establishments. Presence & on-site support: Contact person for organisers and clients during the event on site, conducting briefings on location and ensuring smooth operation. Interface: Preparation and leadership of internal event meetings to ensure all operational departments are perfectly briefed and prepared. Leadership & quality: Leadership and development of the Event Coordinator as well as co-design of clear operational standards and templates. Follow-up: Recording all services provided in the PMS/CRM to prepare error-free final billing. Who you are Education & experience: Ideally a bachelor’s degree or training in hospitality, event management or business administration, as well as at least three years of experience in hotel events or event planning, ideally focusing on meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment. Organisational talent: Exceptional attention to detail, a confident sense of priorities and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Process & system knowledge: Proficient use of PMS, CRM and event management systems as well as excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills. Personality: Reliable, solution-oriented and resilient; you build sustainable relationships with demanding guests as well as all operational departments. Language skills: Fluent and stylistically confident German and English, both spoken and written; additional languages are an advantage. Start date: October or by arrangement. If you would like to help shape the future of the event sector within the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your complete application documents. Benefits At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous discounts.

jobs.description: People at 1800 metres above sea level shape luxury mountain travel. Our dynamic and international team offers our guests smart luxury for an unparalleled holiday experience. As a team member of the luxurious Kulm Group, you are part of the key to our success. Together we make every stay inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we live our culture: discreet luxury, inspiration and life experience. Together we make this possible. This is your chance to become part of our defining culture: This is what you will achieve with us: Are you a sales-strong personality with a passion for luxury hospitality? Do you love building strong customer relationships, driving commercial growth and designing customised event concepts in two of the most iconic houses in the Alps? As part of the strategic realignment of our event organisation for the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina , we are looking for a sales-oriented Event Sales Manager for our Brand & Commercial Team. This is not a classic operational scheduling role – but a strategic role in business development, where you independently manage the commercial customer journey from the first enquiry to contract conclusion. Your mission: Proactive Business Development: You identify and acquire new potentials in the MICE, corporate and social events sectors for both luxury hotels – with a special focus on strengthening the low seasons. End-to-End Sales Ownership: You manage the entire sales cycle from qualification through customised offers to negotiation and contract conclusion. Relationship & Account Management: You build long-term, strategic partnerships with agencies, event planners and corporate clients and ensure sustainable repeat business. Customer Experience & Site Inspections: You conduct inspiring house tours, develop exciting event concepts tailored to both brand worlds and act as a valued commercial advisor. Seamless Interface: You work closely with the teams from revenue, marketing, sales and the operational departments and hand over booked events to operations in a structured manner. This is you: Experience: At least 5 years of proven success in event sales, MICE sales or hospitality sales. Education: Successfully completed bachelor’s degree with an economic/business administration focus (or comparable qualification). Mindset: A proactive, sales-oriented personality with strong negotiation skills, networking talent and high personal responsibility. Digital & Tool Affinity: Confident handling of common PMS, CRM and event management systems as well as MS Office 365. Languages: Business fluent German and English skills, both spoken and written. Bridge Builder: Ability to harmoniously connect commercial goals with operational processes on site. What we offer you: Shape the future: The chance to actively shape the development and expansion of our new commercial event organisation. Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours, modern workplace at the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and an established home office policy . Culture: A dynamic, collegial environment within the Brand & Commercial Team with plenty of room for personal development. Ready to shape the future of our events? Then we look forward to your application! Benefits At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous discounts.
